channel.title: Today's Walk, Let's Talk
channel.description: Today's Walk, Let's Talk is a short audio show about dogs: why they sniff, how they bond with people, and what recent research can and cannot say. Every voice is an AI character, not a real person and not a veterinarian, trainer or researcher. Episodes share general information only. Where an episode draws on a published study, the links appear on the episode page so you can read the source yourself. For your dog's health or behavior, ask your own vet or a qualified trainer. Cover art and character portraits are AI-generated and do not depict real people. The show is made by TurtleRock Paws, a dog boarding business in Irvine, California.

channel.itunes:subtitle: Calm conversations about dogs, told by AI characters around one round table. General information, not veterinary advice.

item.title: Journal Club: the dog in the bedroom and how you sleep
item.description: A new study compared the nights adults had a dog in the bedroom with their own nights sleeping alone, using a wrist tracker: nearly twelve thousand people in all, about four thousand of them in the dog group. Our readers read the whole paper: what it found, why the differences are so small, and the one thing it could not measure. AI voices sharing general information, not veterinary advice. For your dog's health, ask your vet.

item.title: Mixed-breed DNA surprises: why looks fool us
item.description: Why does a mixed-breed dog's DNA result so often surprise its family? Mike and Bea look at three peer-reviewed studies on guessing ancestry by eye, the few genes behind coat type, and how little breed tells us about one dog's behavior. No breed names, no rankings. AI voices sharing general information, not veterinary advice. For your dog's health, ask your vet.
